Process Reward Models (PRM) vs. Outcome Reward Models (ORM)
• Outcome (ORM): Evaluates only final trajectory answer; blind to intermediate hallucinations.
• Process (PRM): Assigns dense credit R(s_t, a_t) at each latent reasoning step.
• Pruning Efficiency: PRM early pruning saves 72% compute in Monte Carlo exploration trees.
Test-time compute replaces parameter bloat: 10x compute = +18% accuracy on logic benchmarks.
